artDirection.summary: Original 2D illustrated City Horizon key art: a warm dusk city seen as a cinematic poster, with layered skyline, dramatic boulevard perspective, park, water, tiny citizens, lights and an active construction crane. It must read as commercial game illustration rather than a 3D render, gameplay capture or asset showcase.
rules: render as layered 2D illustration, not a 3D model showcase
no gameplay grid, footprint logic, CH_CAMERA_V1 or current asset inventory constraints
build depth with foreground, midground, distant skyline and atmospheric haze
prefer broad painted shapes, soft glows, varied silhouettes and poster composition
allow invented architecture, construction, parks, water and city life
leave upper-left breathing room for logo treatment
do not bake logo or loading text into the art
